comment: Examine text for world objects, by their key. Items keep theirs in items.json.

objects.tree_stump: Someone's been chopping here. It'll grow back.
objects.dead_tree: Grey and leafless. The ash killed it long ago, but the wood is still good.
objects.dead_tree_stump: All that's left of a dead tree.
objects.tin_rock: A rock with flecks of tin.
objects.iron_rock: Rust-red veins of iron run through this rock.
objects.anvil: Heavy, scarred iron. Used for smithing.
objects.bank_booth: The clerk keeps the town's valuables safe.
objects.market_stall: A trader's stall, piled with wares.
objects.altar: A quiet altar to the Dawn.
objects.statue: A weathered statue of some old hero of Kelmoor.
objects.standing_stone: An ancient stone. It hums faintly when you touch it.
objects.log_pile: Neatly stacked logs, ready for the yard.
objects.hide_tent: A tent of stitched hides. It smells of smoke.
objects.goblin_totem: A crude totem hung with bones and feathers.
objects.copper_rock_stump: There's no ore left in this rock right now.
objects.tin_rock_stump: There's no ore left in this rock right now.
objects.iron_rock_stump: There's no ore left in this rock right now.
objects.coal_rock_stump: There's no ore left in this rock right now.
objects.furnace: A roaring furnace. Hot enough to smelt ore into bars.
objects.range: A big iron cooking range. Something smells good.
objects.shallow_fishing_spot: Little fish are darting about in the shallows.
objects.deep_fishing_spot: Something big is moving down there.
objects.aldric: A broad-shouldered bladesmith with scarred forearms.
objects.banker: Keeps Kelmoor's valuables safe and its ledgers neat.
objects.oak_tree: A thick-trunked oak. Hard work, good wood.
objects.oak_tree_stump: Someone's been chopping here. It'll grow back.
objects.willow_tree: A willow leaning out over the water.
objects.willow_tree_stump: Someone's been chopping here. It'll grow back.
objects.yew_tree: Dark and ancient. Elderglen is full of them.
objects.yew_tree_stump: Someone's been chopping here. It'll grow back.
objects.starwood_tree: There is a faint light in the grain of this wood.
objects.gold_rock: Bright flecks of gold run through this rock.
objects.cobalt_rock: Deep blue ore. It takes a good pickaxe.
objects.glacite_rock: Pale blue ore. The rock is cold to touch.
objects.gold_rock_stump: There's no ore left in this rock right now.
objects.cobalt_rock_stump: There's no ore left in this rock right now.
objects.verdite_rock_stump: There's no ore left in this rock right now.
objects.glacite_rock_stump: There's no ore left in this rock right now.
objects.gravestone: A worn gravestone. The name has weathered away.
objects.cactus: Spiny and swollen with water. Best left alone.
objects.palm_tree: A palm leaning over the oasis.
objects.aether_stone: Pale stone with a cold light in it. You can't work it yet.
objects.glyph_shrine: An old shrine for inscribing glyphs. Nobody here remembers how.
objects.spinning_wheel: A spinning wheel, waiting for flax.
objects.homestead_gate: A gate to a plot of your own, if you ever buy one.
objects.cave_entrance: A dark cave mouth. Something moves inside.
objects.training_dummy: A straw dummy, patient about being hit.
objects.archery_target: A painted target, peppered with old arrow holes.
objects.mara: Runs the General Store. Knows the price of everything.
objects.elder_maren: Kelmoor's elder. She has sworn in more newcomers than anyone can count.
objects.brenna: Kelmoor's smith. She talks in short sentences.
objects.tamsin: The Blue Gull's keeper. Pours a fair measure.
objects.orrin: Sells glyphs and robes, and talks about neither.
objects.ysolde: The Scriptorium's librarian. Reads while she walks.
objects.jory: Runs the sawmill. Sawdust in his beard.
objects.gunnar: Falcrest's smith, and proud of its forge.
objects.nazir: Keeps the Qadir smelter running day and night.
objects.dunstan: Keeps the Brightwater store. Always sweeping.
objects.gerrick: Sells nets and rods, and tells fishing stories.
objects.exchange_clerk: A clerk of the Bourse, surrounded by ledgers.
objects.market_trader: Hawking wares from a stall in the square.
